public_evidence_threshold: No publicly attributable research claim in a product case
Research/analytics offered generally; no verified FMCG case process
Named FMCG project shows category/competitor audit or consumer insight but lacks an explicit primary-data method
At least one named FMCG project identifies a real primary consumer-data method, OR two detailed category audits with insights
At least two separate FMCG brands have named primary consumer methods, OR one FMCG project documents more than one independent primary research method
At least one named FMCG project clearly documents both qualitative and quantitative consumer research PLUS concept/positioning/package testing feeding an actual decision
No attributable branding strategy evidence
General strategy/positioning service only
At least one FMCG project states positioning or intended platform with limited rationale
One FMCG project links category/audience finding to an explicit positioning and resulting packaging decision
Two FMCG case narratives show strategic deliverables and clear decision chains
Two distinct FMCG brands each show the consumer/market problem, concrete positioning choice and its manifestation in product design
No confirmed FMCG physical packaging case
Packaging service mentioned but no attributable implementation
At least one named FMCG packaging result is illustrated
One detailed packaging case explains shelf/category, product-information or consumer perception challenge
Two distinct product cases explain specific packaging design decisions
Two or more FMCG cases in distinct product subcategories each link business/consumer problems to design solutions and demonstrate a reusable visual grammar
No FMCG SKU/line evidence
Multiple designs or taste variants visible; repeat rules unknown
One named project uses repeatable differentiated SKU signifiers
One project documents multi-SKU rules, brandbook or system across line variants
Either at least two separate FMCG cases evidence reusable variant rules, OR one case documents implementation across 10+ SKU with a system

An actual FMCG project demonstrates documented transfer to client (brandbook/guide/toolkit) AND operational scaling across numerous SKUs, form factors or multiple subcategories; not a conceptual promise alone
One publicly confirmed FMCG product family
Two distinguishable FMCG product subcategories within one broad sector (food/drinks or non-food)
Three or more documented FMCG subcategories within one broad sector
Publicly attributable product packaging in both food/drinks and non-food FMCG
Food/drink and non-food cases spanning at least four distinct subcategories
Food/drink and non-food cases spanning at least six distinct subcategories, with attributable case evidence for each
